per_depth.common_affordance: The statement directly exposes the problem as a three-coloring constraint on an interference graph.
The statement is exactly an undirected graph 3-coloring problem: tasks are vertices, conflicts are edges, and operational blocks are the three colors.
The arithmetic link rule degenerates exactly into the constraint that adjacent vertices must receive different values, so the task is ordinary 3-coloring.
The energy formula together with the target 4m makes the global constraint exactly equivalent to requiring different values on every edge, i.e. 3-colorability.
The channel rules collapse every communication-link constraint to the requirement that its endpoints receive different values from {1,2,3}, i.e. ordinary graph 3-coloring.
